name: Severe Weather Outcome
description: One automatic after-the-fact verdict from the daily outcome ledger (warnings_engine/outcomes.py): did extreme weather actually follow an episode (verified = hit, unverified = evidence of a false alarm), or did a disaster-grade extreme arrive with no warning-tier episode at all (candidate_miss)? Evidence base for a future HUMAN-TRIGGERED retraining run - nothing consumes these rows automatically. Admin-only, never sent to clients. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.description: verified = extremes materialized after the episode (hit); unverified = nothing extreme followed (evidence of a false alarm); candidate_miss = disaster-grade extremes observed with no warning-tier episode active

fields.label: Warning Episode
fields.description: The judged episode - empty for candidate_miss rows (there was no episode; that is the point)

fields.label: Period Start (UTC)
fields.description: Start of the observed window the verdict is based on (episode onset, or the start of the quiet-scan window)

fields.label: Period End (UTC)
fields.description: End of the observed window (episode valid_until + 48 h aftermath, capped at the data horizon)

fields.label: Peak 24h Precip (mm)
fields.description: Max 24 h precipitation sum observed in the window. Duplicated out of the evidence JSON for list/report use.

fields.label: Peak Precip Pctl
fields.description: The peak 24 h fall on the cell's own climatological weekly-sum percentile curve (conservative measure; empty when the cell has no Weather Cell Climatology row)

fields.label: Peak Gust (m/s)
fields.description: Max 10 m wind gust observed in the window. Duplicated out of the evidence JSON for list/report use.

fields.label: Evidence (admin only)
fields.description: JSON schema v1: {version, kind: episode|quiet_scan, window, observed: {max_precip_24h_mm, precip_peak_at, precip_weekly_pctl, max_gust_ms, gust_peak_at, gust_pctl}, climatology_available, thresholds, source, data_horizon, episode?}. Never sent to clients.
